newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip in directionless trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip in directionless trade.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Thursday in trade lacking clear direction, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen to 1.2 yen per kg lower. Most-active benchmark August was off 1.0 yen at 150.8 yen.
The market opened weaker on the yen's firmer tendency, and rebonded slightly in line with the currency market, they said.

Activity was featureless. "Private investors' interest in the rubber futures market is thin. Investors are tending to sell futures on any price rebound," a trading house trader said. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-7431
